summary: JIP-28 allocates JitoSOL stake to validators running BAM software via tiered delegation triggered by adoption thresholds. Requests six-month temporary control of Steward parameters (recipient unspecified) with auto-revocation. No direct treasury expenditure. Depends on JIP-27 passage.
